card.name: "Each" or "a" before year
card.fires_on: The word "each" or "a" right after a count or amount, where the next word is a time unit like year, month or day. It marks a yearly or daily rate.

modes.label: each + year
modes.description: "each" after a large number of people, cases or events, followed by "year".
modes.example: Located in New York City, Saint Patrick’s Cathedral hosts over 5.5 million people<< each>> year to visit and pray.

modes.label: a + time unit
modes.description: "a" after a quantity, meaning per year, month or day.
modes.example: attracts more than 30,000 visitors<< a>> year.

card.writes: It promotes time-period words such as season and since, which fits a time unit coming next.
card.plain: It spots the "each" or "a" in phrases like "a million cases each year", where a time unit comes next.
